info.description:
This course creates opportunities for students to strengthen and integrate knowledge through on-the-job training and learning at organizations.

Provide students environments to initially apply knowledge obtained at the university in reality. Develop the ability of critical thinking and problem solving during the internship period. In addition, students could participate to analyze, do research, and solve specific problems related to human resource management and other fields.
